Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step in the problem:

Hint 1: Consider the structure of the design matrix $\mathbb{X}$. The first column of $\mathbb{X}$ is a bias (intercept) column, which means it is a column of ones. How does this relate to the vector $\mathbf{1}$?

Hint 2: Think about the definition of "span" in linear algebra. If a vector is in the span of a set of vectors, it can be expressed as a linear combination of those vectors. Can the vector $\mathbf{1}$ be expressed as a linear combination of the columns of $\mathbb{X}$?
